theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f.seq s).Finite := by
  let f' : α → β := Classical.choice f
  have hf' : Function.Surjective f' := Set.Finite.surjOn_of_finite hf hs
  exact Set.Finite.of_surjOn f' hf' hs
